metadata.question: Between January 29 and February 5, 2019, was there at least a 22 degree Celcius difference in the highest daily air temperature at 2 meters in Boston, MA?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about temperature difference in Boston, MA between Jan 29-Feb 5, 2019. I need to: 1. Find temperature data - ERA5 or MODIS LST could work, but ERA5 is better for air temperature 2. Define Boston geometry as a point 3. Get daily maximum temperature at 2m for each day in the date range 4. Calculate the difference between the highest and lowest daily max temperatures 5. Check if this difference is ≥22°C For ERA5 data, I'll use the ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY collection which has 'mean_2m_air_temperature' band. I need to convert from Kelvin to Celsius. I should: - Check if collection has data - Calculate daily max temperatures - Find the range (max daily temp - min daily temp) - Validate the result is reasonable (not NaN, not extreme values) - Output the answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var boston = ee.Geometry.Point(-71.0589, 42.3601); var startDate = '2019-01-29'; var endDate = '2019-02-06'; // Exclusive end date // 2. Data Acquisition - ERA5 Daily for air temperature at 2m var tempCollection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY') .filterBounds(boston) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('mean_2m_air_temperature'); var collectionSize = tempCollection.size().getInfo(); print(`ERA5 Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { print("No temperature data found for the date range"); print("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get daily max temperatures var tempStats = tempCollection.map(function(image) { var date = image.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd'); var tempK = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: boston, scale: 1000 }).get('mean_2m_air_temperature'); // Convert Kelvin to Celsius var tempC = ee.Number(tempK).subtract(273.15); return ee.Feature(null, { 'date': date, 'tempC': tempC }); }); var tempList = tempStats.reduceColumns({ reducer: ee.Reducer.toList(2), selectors: ['date', 'tempC'] }).get('list').getInfo(); // 4. Calculation - Find temperature range var temps = tempList.map(item => item[1]); var dates = tempList.map(item => item[0]); print("Daily Temperatures:"); for (var i = 0; i < dates.length; i++) { print(`${dates[i]}: ${temps[i].toFixed(1)}°C`); } var maxTemp = Math.max(...temps); var minTemp = Math.min(...temps); var tempRange = maxTemp - minTemp; print(`Max Temp: ${maxTemp.toFixed(1)}°C, Min Temp: ${minTemp.toFixed(1)}°C`); print(`Temperature Range: ${tempRange.toFixed(1)}°C`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (tempRange === null || isNaN(tempRange) || tempRange > 100 || tempRange < -100) { print("C3"); } else if (tempRange >= 22) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
